segments.description: Mixing ingredients in a glass bowl with a spoon.
Pouring semolina and water into a bowl and stirring.
Pouring the soaked semolina and cooked rice into a blender jar.
Pouring the blended mixture into a bowl and mixing.
Grating an apple onto a small plate.
Adding salt and coriander leaves to the batter and stirring.
Adding grated apple into the batter and mixing thoroughly.
Cooking the pancakes in a pan and serving them on a plate.
